model: V6.1 Participation x Location x Regime Research Lab
objective: Test whether V6 participation signal becomes investable when conditioned on price location and market/sector regime; no live score.
method: Weekly point-in-time observations; stock-own-history participation bins x 120D price location x contemporaneous market and sector regimes; outcomes 10/20/40/60D.
limitations: Current-universe survivorship bias; current industry mapping; ETF tracking error; no costs/slippage; weekly observations overlap at longer horizons; OHLCV cannot prove institutional accumulation.
